rules.title: Just Cause Requirement for Evictions
rules.requirement: A landlord must have one of 17 permitted 'just cause' reasons to evict a tenant from a rental unit covered by the Rent Ordinance.

coverage.summary: Covers rental units covered by the Rent Ordinance, including some units exempt from rent increases such as post-June 13, 1979 construction and Costa-Hawkins eligible units.

rules.quoted_span: In order to evict a tenant from a rental unit covered by the Rent Ordinance, a landlord must have a "just cause" reason that is the dominant motive for pursuing the eviction.
